messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: could not find function "renderImage"
parts:
renderImage is only in the development version on GitHub - the docs were updated on the tutorial page a bit early.

If you want to experiment with it, you can install that version with:
install.packages('devtools')
devtools::install_github('shiny', 'rstudio')
